---
name: Report a bug
about: Tell us what went wrong in the editor.
---

Issues and comments are public and show your GitHub account. Do not include private circuits, screenshots, credentials, personal information, or security details.

## What did you try?

What did you expect to happen, and what actually happened?

## Steps to reproduce

What are the fewest steps someone can follow to reproduce the bug?

## Impact

Was any work lost, or were you blocked from continuing?

## Optional context

Which browser were you using? Were you in Editing or Run mode?
